mechanism: Mycophenolate inhibits inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase in the de novo purine synthesis pathway, which can impair folate-dependent nucleotide synthesis; folic acid supplementation may help mitigate mycophenolate-induced bone marrow suppression and folate deficiency.
action: Folic acid supplementation (1 mg daily) is recommended as a standard supportive measure in patients receiving mycophenolate to reduce hematologic toxicity and prevent folate deficiency-related complications.
